components.name: ncmdump
components.notes: Source lives under Resources/ThirdParty/ncmdump; Xcode copies the ncmdump folder to the app bundle Resources root.

components.name: apple-music-downloader
components.notes: Project-private macOS executable and libtemari.dylib embedded in the app bundle Resources root. Built from the Get Oudio fork of zhaarey/apple-music-downloader with script/build_apple_music_downloader.sh. Runtime config is generated from apple-music-downloader/config.yaml.template under the app-managed runtime directory.

managedRuntimes.name: Apple Music wrapper-lite QEMU
managedRuntimes.notes: The non-sandbox Runtime Worker downloads a SHA-256-pinned QEMU package into the external managed runtime. The mutable account data.img is kept outside the versioned package. Existing Colima data is not touched during installation or update.
